name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Tactical Command Gauntlet TCG-5
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Tactical Command Gauntlet TCG-5
description: A forearm-mounted tactical computing and communications platform that integrates real-time mapping, squad tracking, drone control, and encrypted communications into a ruggedized wrist-worn unit. The TCG-5 features a flexible display that wraps around the forearm, providing a large-format tactical map accessible at a glance. It connects to squad members' neural interfaces, displaying their positions, status, and sensor feeds in an integrated common operating picture. The gauntlet can control up to 4 drones simultaneously, manage automated defensive systems, and coordinate fire support requests through an encrypted uplink.

specifications.info: 20x8 cm; 10 km range; impact resistant; EMP hardened

story_hooks: A stolen TCG-5 still had active squad tracking links — the thief could see the real-time positions of an Arcturus security team without them knowing their movements were compromised.
A TCG-5's drone control interface was exploited to hijack an operator's own drones mid-mission — the drones were turned against the squad they were supposed to protect.

physical_description.visual_profile: A rigid-yet-flexible tactical forearm platform combining military engineering with wearable tech aesthetics. The primary housing wraps around the ventral forearm like a reinforced vambrace, with a segmented flexible OLED display dominating the interior surface. The overall silhouette is angular and modular, with accessory mounting points along the edges.
physical_description.dimensions: 20 cm length × 8 cm width when wrapped around forearm; approximately 3-4 cm thick at control module
physical_description.weight_description: 0.6 kg—handheld equivalent weight, worn but not burdensome for extended tactical operations
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced graphite-composite housing with titanium mounting brackets; flexible polymer substrate for display segment
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal gunmetal with slight anti-reflective coating; brushed texture on control surfaces to prevent slip
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with neon cyan accent lighting; black rubber grip zones; status LEDs in amber and tactical red
physical_description.interface_elements: Segmented flexible OLED wrap-around display (20×8 cm), seven tactile pressure-sensitive buttons along right edge, rotary input dial near wrist junction, three hardened USB-C ports (charging, data, drone link), haptic feedback actuators embedded in housing
distinctive_features: Flexible forearm-wrap OLED display with visible segment divisions
Four corner-mounted drone control nodes with independent status LEDs
Arcturus Defense Solutions chevron logo stamped in metallic ink on dorsal mounting plate
EMP-hardened antenna bulge at proximal wrist
Modular quick-release battery cartridge with remaining-charge indicator bar
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ARCTURUS DEFENSE SOLUTIONS embossed on dorsal surface; regulatory stamps (GLMZ Corps Standard TCG-5, Tier 3+) along lower edge; serial number laser-etched on battery cartridge
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn with light scuff marks and dust; display showing active squad position markers, drone feed thumbnails, and tactical overlay; status LEDs cycling through connection confirmations

The flexible OLED display glows cyan, showing a live tactical map with squad member icons and drone flight paths. Chrome and brushed steel surfaces catch highlights. Surrounding the gauntlet: rifle cartridges, encrypted data chip, drone remote, all arranged on a carbon-fiber mat.
